title: Standard layout slice: brand pack JSON schema and validator, Python with TypeScript-shared vectors (first slice of PPY-88a883)
description:
Outcome: The brand pack format (role colours light and dark, font from an allow-list, logo, wordmark, image-style slot) as a versioned JSON schema and a validator: WCAG AA contrast for every text/fill pair in both themes, lightness difference for colour-safe pairs, font allow-list. Vectors in a shared JSON file so the newsroom's TypeScript twin can reuse them later. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) brand-pack-validator, branch feature/<this issue id>-brand-pack-validator from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-brand-pack-validator, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new src/papyrus_content/brand_pack/ (schema.json, validate.py, tests), scripts/fixtures/brand-pack-vectors.json.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/brand-pack-validator.feature):
Scenario: A low-contrast pack is refused naming the pair
    Given a pack whose body text fails contrast in dark mode
    When it is validated
    Then it is refused naming the failing pair

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-88a883.

Testing: poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/brand_pack; poetry run behave features_backend/brand-pack-validator.feature.
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
